title: Phase 2：規則 26 在奇數寬度環上的週期 w·2^⌊log₂ w⌋（OEIS A334504 的猜想）

R3-L01.proof: complete paper proof and Lean proof for all odd w >= 3 (rule26_odd_period, iter_eq_one_iff), CI lean run 45017724157; numeric check odd w <= 61 with two independent simulations

novelty.note: PROVEN_KNOWN means the statement already appears in OEIS (as a conjecture); it does not mean a prior proof exists. The formula itself is stated in OEIS A334504 FORMULA (Zabolotskii 2024) as a conjecture ('It seems that'); no proof found in scope. The proof is NO_MATCH_IN_SCOPE. Not checked: Math Fun mailing list (Klee 2020), MathSciNet, zbMATH, Google Scholar. The even-index conjecture a(2n+2) = A268754(n) is not proven here.
